name: B6000 - Printer Control
description: Intent: Block-tier hard enforcement on Printer sent_to_printer events at sensitivity floor [3,4] — shuts down sensitive content being printed to non-sanctioned printers (home offices, ad-hoc network printers, kiosk printers). Exclusions: excludes printers in Printers_Authorized_Printer_Names_[is]; ships disabled by default — enable only after every corporate-managed printer is in the Authorized list and W6010 reviews are clean. Requirements: WIP — pending analyst testing.
